quote: The Alameda - Melipilla Rail Depot Project covers an area of 17.83 hectares with a construction area of about 22,000 square meters and a total investment of USD 90 million. It will provide comprehensive train maintenance… Completion is expected by the end of 2026.
note: Opened CREC English release 14 Apr 2025 (USD 90m Melipilla depot; groundbreaking 26 Mar 2025).
